purpose: Canonical closure vocabulary and coverage rules for the person-centered defense-router intake. The builder and validator BOTH consume this file. It exists to stop partial coverage being reported as completion via permissive labels.

not_searched.meaning: Source named but never inspected this pass.

partially_searched.meaning: Inspected but deliberately incomplete (subset / decision-maker-only / defense-relevant-only / continuation lane).

surface_complete.meaning: The entire source surface was enumerated (e.g. a hash-pinned full list).

unavailable_after_search.meaning: Documented fetch/search attempts failed; source not usable.

identity_unresolved_after_search.meaning: Searched, but the underlying entity/person identity could not be resolved.

rule_partial_cannot_be_complete: A coverage/frontier row in ANY terminal state (surface_complete, unavailable_after_search, identity_unresolved_after_search) whose note/selection_rule contains any partial_marker MUST fail. Terminal means terminal.
rule_after_search_needs_provenance: Any state ending in '_after_search' (unavailable_after_search, identity_unresolved_after_search) MUST carry either a search_ref resolving to a search-ledger row, OR the tuple (query, attempted_urls, timestamp, result). The mere existence of role-claims/affiliations does NOT constitute a search. Otherwise the row must be not_searched.
rule_coverage_receipt_source_specific: Each roster/portfolio coverage row MUST carry a source_url and a receipt whose locator_url equals that source_url. A receipt pointing at a different fund (e.g. an 8VC receipt on a Pallas row) is a failure.
rule_gross_count_support: A numeric gross_observed is allowed only when gross_basis=='exact' AND every name was preserved (gross_observed==enumerated). Otherwise gross_observed MUST be null with gross_basis in ['estimated','unknown'] and any approximate figure in gross_estimated.

denominator_rule.name: investment-decision-maker universe
denominator_rule.definition: The candidate denominator is NOT the full gross roster. It is the bounded set of investment decision-makers plus the committed LinkedIn projection people plus the seed overlay.
inclusion: fund roster people whose stated title is Founder/Partner/Managing Partner/General Partner/Managing Director/Principal/Senior Principal/Venture Partner/Operating Partner/Senior Advisor/Board
exclusion: operations / finance / legal / IR / EA / communications / office staff on fund team pages
denominator_rule.reporting: Each roster source records gross_observed and enumerated counts; the denominator equals the sum of enumerated decision-makers (deduped), never called 'the full roster'.

rule_every_required_source_has_dispositi: Each required roster source and portfolio source MUST appear in the coverage ledgers (roster-coverage.jsonl / portfolio-coverage.jsonl) with a coverage_state from coverage_states. Absence is a validation failure.
rule_subset_not_complete: A portfolio whose selection_rule is a subset (defense-relevant, decision-maker, etc.) is partially_searched, never surface_complete, unless the full source surface was enumerated (source_total == enumerated_total).

award_receipt_rule.rule: Every government-award row MUST cite a USAspending-specific receipt (id prefix r-usaspending-) whose locator_url is the award's usaspending.gov page. No award row may cite r-fund-portfolio-census-2026 or any portfolio/roster receipt.
award_receipt_rule.rule_identity_gate: A company whose identity_state is 'held' or 'unresolved' MUST NOT be treated as an identity-resolved award. Cambium is held unless its gate passes (exact recipient_legal_name match to the defense-tech entity).

rule_counterpart_provenance: A counterpart search claiming a searched result (no_counterpart_confirmation_observed / third_party_reported_not_counterpart_confirmed) MUST list inspected_urls and a result_status. Generic 'web search' prose without inspected_urls is provenance_quality=query_only and may not back a durable-closure claim; such rows carry provenance_quality explicitly.

completion_evidence.rule_report_partial_first: The final report leads with what remains partial/unavailable/unresolved; it may not headline 'frontier closed' or 'not_searched=0' unless EVERY required source and frontier row is in a terminal_state.
